job.title: Commercial Gas Engineer
job.description:
Commercial Gas Engineer - Glasgow & Ayr - Salary up to £47,000 DOE

We are currently recruiting for an experienced Commercial Gas Engineer to join an established and growing engineering team, working across a varied portfolio of commercial and domestic properties throughout West Scotland.

This is a varied role suited to an engineer with a strong commercial gas, plumbing and heating background, particularly someone with experience working within Facilities Management environments.

You will be responsible for servicing, maintaining, fault finding and installing a range of commercial heating and gas systems across a diverse customer base.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Carry out servicing, maintenance, repairs and installation of commercial gas and heating systems.
  • Work across a varied portfolio including hotel chains, care homes, farms and commercial properties.
  • Complete planned preventative maintenance and reactive breakdown works.
  • Diagnose faults and carry out repairs safely and efficiently.
  • Complete relevant service reports, documentation and compliance records.
  • Liaise professionally with customers, clients and site teams.
  • Ensure all works are completed in line with relevant gas, health & safety and company procedures.
  • Participate in a 1-in-6 on-call rota, receiving an additional £130 standby payment.
  • Work across Glasgow, Ayrshire, the West of Scotland and surrounding areas.
  • Develop knowledge and experience in renewable technologies, including biomass and heat pump systems, with training provided.

Person Specification:

  • Relevant Commercial Gas qualifications/tickets.
  • A strong background in commercial gas, plumbing and heating.
  • Experience working across commercial or Facilities Management (FM) environments.
  • Experience with servicing, maintenance, fault finding and repairs.
  • Strong customer service and communication skills.
  • The ability to work independently and manage your own workload.
  • A full UK driving licence.
  • A professional approach to health & safety and compliance.
  • Experience with biomass and heat pump systems would be advantageous, but is not essential as full training will be provided.
Salary & Benefits:

  • 30 days' annual leave including bank holidays.
  • 1-in-6 on-call rota with £130 standby payment.
  • Company van provided for business use.
  • Christmas shutdown.
  • Full training and development in biomass and heat pump technologies.
  • Opportunity to work across a varied portfolio of commercial properties.
  • Stable, long-term opportunity with an established engineering operation.
  • Ongoing development within the wider heating and renewable energy sector.

job.title: Data Centre Technical Manager
job.description:
Data Centre Technical Manager - Client Direct - Central London - up to 80k + bonus and excellent benefits

Are you from a data centre or critical engineering background?

Would you like to work client side for a leading Data Centre company?

If so, please read on....

One of the market leaders in the data centre world is currently looking to recruit a Data Centre Technical Services Manager to work at a high profile data centre based in Central London. 

The role will be working closely with the Head of Operations on site and will be responsible for overseeing and coordinating all engineering activities within the data centre, to ensure optimal performance, efficiency, and reliability of critical infrastructure systems.

The main duties of the role are as follows:
  • Lead and supervise a team of engineers and technicians, providing guidance, training, and support to ensure they perform their duties effectively.
  • Plan, schedule, and prioritize maintenance, repairs, and upgrades of electrical, mechanical, and HVAC systems to minimize downtime and maintain uptime SLAs.
  • Implement and enforce safety protocols and procedures to ensure compliance with regulatory standards and industry best practices.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including facilities management, IT operations, and security to address issues and optimize data centre operations.
  • Manage vendor relationships and contracts for equipment procurement, maintenance services, and technical support.
  • Maintain technical documentation within the data centre including SOP's/EOP's/MOP's, Electrical safety rules and risk assessments.
  • Participate in capacity planning and expansion projects to support the growth of the data centre infrastructure.
  • Act as a company HVAP.
  • Be available as the 1st point of escalation for any incidents or issues.
Applicants for the role must be able to meet the following criteria:
  • Qualifications in Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience in data centre operations or a similar critical infrastructure environment.
  • Proven track record of leading and managing technical teams.
  • Strong understanding of data centre infrastructure, including power, cooling, security, and network systems.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and demanding environment.
  • Leadership and team management skills.
  • Excellent problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills.
  • Project management and organizational skills.
  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking.

job.title: Mobile Electrical Maintenance Engineer

CBW Staffing Solutions is currently recruiting for 2 x Mobile Electrical Maintenance Engineers to join a leading Facilities Management service provider, covering a portfolio of  infrastructure sites across Kent, including Dartford, Gravesend, Maidstone, Rochester, Sidcup, and Swanley.

This is an excellent opportunity for a qualified Electrical Maintenance Engineer looking to join an established business offering long-term stability, ongoing training, and genuine career progression. The successful candidate will carry out planned preventative and reactive maintenance across a diverse portfolio of sites, ensuring all electrical systems remain safe, compliant, and fully operational while delivering a high standard of customer service.

In return, the company is offering a competitive salary of up to £42,000, excellent benefits, overtime opportunities, and the chance to work on a secure, long-term maintenance contract.

Hours of Work:
  • Monday to Friday
  • 08:00 – 17:00 (40-hour week)
  • 1 in 6 Call-Out Rota

Key Duties & Responsibilities:
  • Carry out planned preventative maintenance (PPM) and reactive electrical maintenance across a portfolio of infrastructure sites.
  • Diagnose and repair faults on lighting, power distribution, and electrical building services systems.
  • Complete lighting maintenance, including lamp replacements, ballast changes, and lighting control systems.

  • Install new sockets, lighting circuits, containment, and complete minor electrical installation works.

  • Complete service reports and maintain accurate maintenance records.

Package:
  • Salary up to £42,000
  • Company Van & Fuel Card
  • 25 Days Holiday + Bank Holidays
  • Overtime Available
  • 1 in 6 Call-Out Rota
  • Company Pension
  • Ongoing Training & Development
  • Career Progression Opportunities

Requirements:
  • City & Guilds / NVQ Level 2 & 3 in Electrical Installation (or equivalent)
  • 18th Edition Wiring Regulations
  • Proven experience within commercial building maintenance or facilities management
  • Strong electrical fault-finding and diagnostic skills
  • Good knowledge of electrical building services
  • Full UK Driving Licence

Please send your CV to Bailey White at CBW Staffing Solutions for more information and to avoid missing out on this opportunity.

job.title: Site Manager

Site Manager - Glasgow- Salary up to £45,000 Plus car allowance DOE

We’re currently recruiting for an experienced Site Manager to join a growing team delivering Smart Home and Renewable Energy projects across Scotland.

As Site Manager, you’ll take responsibility for the successful day-to-day delivery of projects, ensuring work is completed safely, on programme, within budget and to a high standard.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Providing leadership and ensuring high standards of workmanship and customer service.
  • Coordinating with senior management, procurement and supply chain teams to ensure projects are properly planned and resourced.
  • Supporting the delivery of renewable energy installations, including Solar PV and Air Source Heat Pumps, with an understanding of whole-house retrofit.
  • Ensuring compliance with Health & Safety, RAMS, Toolbox Talks and relevant legislation, including PAS 2030 and PAS 2035.
  • Monitoring project programmes, progress, costs and quality.
  • Producing regular project reports and chairing site meetings.
  • Managing customer queries and resolving issues efficiently.
  • Ensuring quality, environmental and health & safety procedures are followed and accurately recorded.
  • Keeping up to date with relevant industry regulations, HSE, Ofgem and retrofit requirements.
Person Specification:
  • Previous experience within renewable energy construction, retrofit or residential installation (Desirable)
  • Experience managing subcontractors and installation teams
  • Strong organisational and problem-solving skills
  • SMSTS
  • First Aid
  • Full UK driving licence
  • Good understanding of Health & Safety and site compliance
  • Flexibility to travel and stay away from home across Scotland
Salary & Benefits:

  • Company vehicle – fully expensed
  • 22 days’ holiday + Bank Holidays

  • Bonus scheme
  • Opportunity to work on a variety of renewable energy and smart home projects

job.title: Lift & Escelator Operations Support
job.description:
Lift & Escalator Operations Support - Office Based - Canary Wharf - £45,000 

CBW Staffing Solutions are recruiting on behalf of a leading property and estate management organisation for a Lift & Escalator Operations Support professional to join their team at a major commercial estate in Canary Wharf.

This is a varied role supporting the Lift & Escalator Services Manager in ensuring a large portfolio of lifts and escalators remains safe, compliant, reliable and operating to a high standard.

The role would suit someone with experience in the lift and escalator industry, or a related building services environment, who has a good understanding of technical operations but also enjoys the coordination, contractor management and administrative side of facilities.


What You'll Be Doing Health, Safety & Compliance
  • Support compliance with Health & Safety legislation, statutory requirements, CDM and permit-to-work procedures.
  • Review contractor RAMS and assist with permit approvals.
  • Maintain records relating to LOLER inspections, audits, defects and contractor performance.
  • Support the management and updating of the lift and escalator asset register.
Asset & Service Management
  • Monitor contractor call-outs, repairs and equipment restoration.
  • Maintain accurate asset, defect and maintenance records using SharePoint and other systems.
  • Carry out routine inspections and condition assessments of lifts and escalators.
  • Monitor planned maintenance programmes, contractor attendance and service performance.
  • Help identify opportunities to improve equipment reliability, availability and overall service delivery.
Contractor Coordination
  • Coordinate contractor activities and monitor performance against agreed standards.
  • Track actions arising from inspections, audits and defect reports.
  • Support major repairs, refurbishments and modernisation projects.
  • Work closely with contractors, engineering teams and internal stakeholders to ensure works are completed safely and efficiently.
Reporting & Administration
  • Keep accurate records of maintenance visits, inspections, repairs and contractor documentation.
  • Maintain departmental trackers covering defects, emergency responses and works in progress.
  • Prepare KPI reports, dashboards and operational performance information.
  • Support meetings, record actions and follow up to ensure they are completed.
  • Assist with purchase orders, invoices and expenditure monitoring.
Emergency & Operational Support
  • Provide support during lift and escalator breakdowns, equipment failures and passenger entrapments.
  • Attend site inspections alongside management and contractors when required.
  • Support engineering teams in maximising equipment availability and minimising downtime.
  • Assist with any other reasonable duties required by the Lift & Escalator Services Manager.
What We're Looking For
  • 3+ years' experience within the lift and escalator industry or a related building services environment.
  • Good understanding of lift and escalator systems, LOLER requirements and industry standards.
  • Strong organisational and administrative skills.
  • Good IT skills, particularly Microsoft Office and SharePoint.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Good technical awareness and understanding of safe working practices.
  • Comfortable coordinating contractors and managing multiple tasks at the same time.
  • A proactive approach with good attention to detail.

job.title: Resident Liaison Officer
job.description:
Resident Liaison Officer - Inverness - Salary up to £30,000 DOE

CBW are currently recruiting for an experienced Resident Liaison Officer to join a leading Renewables team based in Inverness.

The role is focused on ensuring residents are kept fully informed, supported and engaged before, during and after works take place. The successful candidate will build strong relationships with residents, respond to queries and concerns, coordinate information with project teams, and help minimise disruption associated with construction activities.

This is a Inverness - based position with regular travel throughout the north of Scotland, reflecting the geographical spread of current and future projects.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Act as the principal contact for residents throughout the lifecycle of works.
  • Provide clear, accurate and timely information regarding planned works, programme dates, access requirements, progress and completion.
  • Build positive and professional relationships with residents, maintaining trust and confidence throughout the project.
  • Identify resident concerns at an early stage and ensure appropriate action is taken.
  • Communicate changes to programmes, working arrangements or planned activities promptly.
  • Ensure residents understand what to expect before, during and following works to their property or communal areas.
  • Undertake regular visits to properties and residential areas affected by project activities.
  • Engage directly with residents to understand their experience and identify any issues requiring attention.
  • Record and follow up resident queries, requests and concerns through to resolution.
  • Identify individual circumstances or additional support requirements and ensure these are communicated to the appropriate members of the project team.
  • Arrange and participate in resident information meetings, briefings and engagement sessions.
  • Prepare and distribute relevant project information and updates.
  • Support residents in understanding project schedules, key milestones and expected completion dates.
  • Receive and manage resident complaints and concerns in a professional and constructive manner.
  • Work with the relevant project, site and management personnel to investigate and resolve issues.
  • Keep residents informed of progress where an issue cannot be resolved immediately.
  • Monitor outstanding matters and ensure appropriate follow-up takes place.
  • Escalate significant, recurring or unresolved issues to the appropriate level of management.
  • Report hazards, incidents, environmental concerns or other matters requiring management attention.
Person Specification:

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to establish positive relationships with a wide range of people.
  • A professional, approachable and empathetic manner.
  • Strong listening skills and the ability to understand and respond appropriately to resident concerns.
  • Effective problem-solving and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Ability to remain calm and professional when dealing with challenging situations.
  • Strong organisational and administrative skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple enquiries, priorities and deadlines.
  • Good attention to detail and accurate record keeping.
  • Previous experience in a resident-facing, customer service, community engagement or similar role.
  • Experience within construction, housing, property, facilities management, refurbishment or a related environment would be advantageous.
  • Understanding of the challenges and sensitivities associated with working in occupied residential properties.
  • Experience of handling customer complaints, enquiries or service issues.
  • Familiarity with maintaining electronic records and using digital systems.

Salary & Benefits:

  • Salary up to £30,000 DOE
  • Van and fuel card.
  • Ongoing training and professional development.
  • Career progression within a growing renewable energy business.
  • Company pension.
  • Supportive team environment with a strong focus on quality, safety and continuous improvement.

job.title: Soft Services Manager
job.description:
Soft Services Manager – 9-Month FTC Salary: Up to £50,000
Contract: 9-Month Fixed-Term Contract
Location: Greenwich, London
Working Pattern: Hybrid

About the role

My client is currently recruiting for a Soft Services Manager to take a key leadership role within a busy and evolving service environment on a 9-month fixed-term contract.

This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on operational leader who enjoys improving services, developing teams, strengthening client relationships and finding smarter, more efficient ways of working.

You will have responsibility for overseeing operational delivery, supporting and developing management teams, strengthening contract performance and ensuring consistently high standards across a diverse portfolio of services.

The role will suit someone who is confident working at both strategic and operational level and who can turn ideas and recommendations into practical improvements that deliver measurable results.

 

Main Duties 

  • Lead and support operational managers, creating clear accountability and a positive culture of performance, collaboration and continuous improvement.
  • Oversee the effective delivery of Soft Services, ensuring contractual requirements, service standards and operational objectives are consistently achieved.

  • Build strong and professional relationships with clients, establishing effective communication, review and escalation processes.

  • Take ownership of contract performance, ensuring key information, obligations, variations, additional works and upcoming renewals are properly managed.

  • Review staffing structures, resource deployment, agency usage, overtime, supervision and cover arrangements to identify opportunities for greater efficiency.

  • Develop a clear understanding of productivity across different sites and use operational data to improve working practices and service delivery.

  • Strengthen budget and cost controls, working closely with Finance to understand variances, forecasting and operational expenditure.

  • Identify opportunities to improve value for money through procurement, equipment, consumables, stock management and working practices.

  • Introduce effective inspection, audit and performance management processes to ensure quality and compliance.

  • Work closely with relevant Health & Safety, Quality, HR, Finance and Procurement teams to ensure appropriate standards and controls are maintained.

  • Improve management information and introduce practical digital processes for scheduling, reporting, auditing, action tracking and documentation.

  • Strengthen workforce planning, recruitment, induction, training, attendance, succession planning and resource management.

  • Develop forward plans for key contracts, identifying renewal requirements, commercial risks, pricing considerations and opportunities for service improvement.

  • Contribute to the future development of the Soft Services function and provide evidence-based recommendations to senior leadership.

 

About you 

We are looking for someone with strong operational management experience within soft services, facilities management, cleaning, FM or a similar environment.

You will ideally have:

  • Proven experience managing operational teams and managers.

  • Strong contract and client management experience.

  • A good understanding of workforce planning and resource deployment.

  • Experience managing budgets, costs and commercial performance.

  • A track record of delivering operational improvements and efficiencies.

  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills.

  • Experience working with multiple stakeholders across operational and support functions.

  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn data into practical actions.

  • Experience of quality assurance, audits, compliance and performance management.

  • Confidence using digital systems and management information to improve operational control.

  • The ability to work independently while also building effective relationships across an organisation.

Most importantly, you'll be a practical, proactive and credible leader who can engage people, challenge existing ways of working and make improvements happen.

 

Why join?

This is an opportunity to make a real impact during a focused 9-month fixed-term assignment, helping to strengthen operational performance and shape the future direction of Soft Services.

You'll have the opportunity to:

  • Make a genuine impact on service performance and operational efficiency.

  • Lead and develop operational managers and teams.

  • Influence how Soft Services are delivered in the future.

  • Work closely with senior leaders and a range of professional functions.

  • Develop and implement new processes, systems and ways of working.

  • Build strong client relationships and influence service outcomes.

  • Work in a hybrid role based in Greenwich, London.

  • Earn a salary of up to £50,000, depending on experience.

Interested?

If you're an experienced Soft Services or Facilities Management professional looking for a 9-month fixed-term opportunity where you can make a tangible difference, we'd be keen to hear from you.

If you enjoy leading people, improving services and delivering measurable operational results, this could be an excellent next step for you.

 

If you would like to apply for this position please contact claire@cbwstaffingsolutions.com

job.title: Electricial Supervisor
job.description:
Electrical Compliance Supervisor - Glasgow - Salary up to £50,000 DOE

We are seeking an experienced Electrical Compliance Supervisor to join a growing renewable energy business delivering a high volume of domestic energy installations across Scotland.

This is a hands-on technical and supervisory position, responsible for maintaining consistently high standards of electrical quality, compliance and safety across a busy installation programme. You will work closely with a small team of Compliance Inspectors, installation teams and site management, carrying out both remote and on-site inspections across Solar PV, battery storage, Air Source Heat Pumps (ASHP) and Electrical Storage Heating installations.

The role offers a genuine mix of technical, field and office-based responsibilities, including reviewing electrical certification and photographic evidence, supporting installers with technical queries, identifying quality issues and providing coaching and training to installation and inspection teams.

There is also the opportunity for the successful candidate to become, or work towards becoming, a NICEIC Qualifying Supervisor.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Lead and support a team of Compliance Inspectors, ensuring inspection activity keeps pace with a high-volume installation programme.
  • Carry out remote and on-site inspections, reviewing workmanship, materials, installation methods and supporting documentation.
  • Apply strong practical electrical knowledge to assess the installation, wiring, configuration and commissioning of inverters and battery storage systems.
  • Identify and troubleshoot electrical and system faults both remotely and on-site.
  • Provide technical support to installation teams, inspectors and customers, acting as a key point of contact for electrical and system-related queries.
  • Support the training and development of site and office-based colleagues, enabling effective first-line fault diagnosis and technical triage.
  • Liaise with manufacturers and equipment suppliers to resolve technical issues, faults and warranty matters.
  • Monitor installation quality and identify examples of best and poor practice, feeding learning into toolbox talks, training and best-practice guidance.
  • Deliver technical updates, toolbox talks and product awareness sessions to installation and inspection teams.
  • Review photographic evidence and job documentation to ensure installations can be effectively inspected remotely.
  • Ensure electrical installation work meets relevant engineering specifications, BS 7671, NICEIC requirements, MCS standards and applicable health, safety and environmental requirements.
  • Review electrical certificates, including EICs, Minor Works Certificates and EICRs, for accuracy and compliance.
  • Ensure project documentation is complete and meets relevant renewable energy certification requirements before sign-off.
  • Support internal and external quality, compliance and regulatory audits.
Person Specification: You will be an experienced electrical professional with a strong understanding of renewable energy installations and a genuine interest in maintaining high standards of workmanship and compliance.

  • A strong electrical installation background with relevant industry experience.
  • Practical knowledge of Solar PV, battery storage and associated inverter systems.
  • Experience of electrical inspection, testing and fault finding.
  • Good working knowledge of BS 7671.
  • Understanding of MCS requirements and renewable energy compliance.
  • Experience reviewing electrical certification and installation documentation.
  • The ability to diagnose and resolve technical issues both remotely and on-site.
  • NICEIC Qualifying Supervisor experience or an individual working towards this level would be highly desirable.
Salary & Benefits:

  • Salary up to £50,000 DOE
  • Company vehicle and fuel card.
  • Ongoing training and professional development.
  • Career progression within a growing renewable energy business.
  • Company pension.
  • Consistent workload across Solar PV, Battery Storage, EV Charging and Heat Pump projects.
  • Supportive team environment with a strong focus on quality, safety and continuous improvement.

Working Pattern: Full-time, Office-based

The Opportunity

This is an excellent opportunity for an Accounts Assistant to join an established business and take responsibility for a varied finance role, with a particular focus on client invoicing, purchase orders, mailbox management and portal submissions.

job.description:

CBW Staffing Solutions is currently recruiting for a Water Treatment Engineer to join a leading FM Service Provider at a prestigious commercial high-rise building in Central London.

The successful candidate will take responsibility for the site's water treatment and water hygiene compliance, covering cooling towers, domestic hot and cold water, LTHW and chilled water systems. This is a Monday-to-Friday position with no call-out, offering a salary of £48,000 plus overtime.

Hours of Work:
  • Monday to Friday
  • 08:00 – 17:00
  • No call-out

Key Duties & Responsibilities:
  • Manage and monitor cooling towers and evaporative cooling systems.
  • Carry out water sampling, temperature monitoring, dip slides and routine inspections.
  • Oversee cleaning, disinfection and chlorination works.
  • Manage domestic hot and cold water systems.
  • Carry out flushing programmes and monitor low-use outlets.
  • Inspect calorifiers, storage tanks and expansion vessels.
  • Monitor closed-loop heating and chilled water systems.
  • Carry out water quality monitoring, sampling and analysis.
  • Monitor chemical dosing, inhibitor levels and corrosion control.
  • Review chemical and microbiological sampling results.
  • Manage specialist water treatment contractors.
  • Maintain water hygiene records, schematics and compliance documentation.

CBW are currently recruiting for an experienced Resident Liaison Officer to join a leading Renewables team based in Glasgow.

The role is focused on ensuring residents are kept fully informed, supported and engaged before, during and after works take place. The successful candidate will build strong relationships with residents, respond to queries and concerns, coordinate information with project teams, and help minimise disruption associated with construction activities.

This is a Glasgow-based position with regular travel throughout Scotland, reflecting the geographical spread of current and future projects.

  • Identify resident concerns at an early stage and ensure appropriate action is taken.
  • Communicate changes to programmes, working arrangements or planned activities promptly.
  • Ensure residents understand what to expect before, during and following works to their property or communal areas.
  • Undertake regular visits to properties and residential areas affected by project activities.
  • Engage directly with residents to understand their experience and identify any issues requiring attention.
  • Record and follow up resident queries, requests and concerns through to resolution.
  • Identify individual circumstances or additional support requirements and ensure these are communicated to the appropriate members of the project team.

  • Prepare and distribute relevant project information and updates.
  • Support residents in understanding project schedules, key milestones and expected completion dates.
  • Receive and manage resident complaints and concerns in a professional and constructive manner.
  • Work with the relevant project, site and management personnel to investigate and resolve issues.
  • Keep residents informed of progress where an issue cannot be resolved immediately.
  • Monitor outstanding matters and ensure appropriate follow-up takes place.
  • Escalate significant, recurring or unresolved issues to the appropriate level of management.
  • Report hazards, incidents, environmental concerns or other matters requiring management attention.
Person Specification:

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to establish positive relationships with a wide range of people.
  • A professional, approachable and empathetic manner.
  • Strong listening skills and the ability to understand and respond appropriately to resident concerns.
  • Effective problem-solving and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Ability to remain calm and professional when dealing with challenging situations.
  • Strong organisational and administrative skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple enquiries, priorities and deadlines.
  • Good attention to detail and accurate record keeping.
  • Previous experience in a resident-facing, customer service, community engagement or similar role.
  • Experience within construction, housing, property, facilities management, refurbishment or a related environment would be advantageous.
  • Understanding of the challenges and sensitivities associated with working in occupied residential properties.
  • Experience of handling customer complaints, enquiries or service issues.
  • Familiarity with maintaining electronic records and using digital systems.

Salary & Benefits:

  • Salary up to £30,000 DOE
  • Ongoing training and professional development.
  • Career progression within a growing renewable energy business.
  • Company pension.
  • Supportive team environment with a strong focus on quality, safety and continuous improvement.

job.title: Electrical Compliance Supervisor
job.description:
Electrical Compliance Supervisor - Glasgow - Salary up to £45,000 DOE

We are seeking an experienced Electrical Compliance Supervisor to join a growing renewable energy business delivering a high volume of domestic energy installations across Scotland.

This is a hands-on technical and supervisory position, responsible for maintaining consistently high standards of electrical quality, compliance and safety across a busy installation programme. You will work closely with a small team of Compliance Inspectors, installation teams and site management, carrying out both remote and on-site inspections across Solar PV, battery storage, Air Source Heat Pumps (ASHP) and Electrical Storage Heating installations.

The role offers a genuine mix of technical, field and office-based responsibilities, including reviewing electrical certification and photographic evidence, supporting installers with technical queries, identifying quality issues and providing coaching and training to installation and inspection teams.

There is also the opportunity for the successful candidate to become, or work towards becoming, a NICEIC Qualifying Supervisor.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Lead and support a team of Compliance Inspectors, ensuring inspection activity keeps pace with a high-volume installation programme.
  • Carry out remote and on-site inspections, reviewing workmanship, materials, installation methods and supporting documentation.
  • Apply strong practical electrical knowledge to assess the installation, wiring, configuration and commissioning of inverters and battery storage systems.
  • Identify and troubleshoot electrical and system faults both remotely and on-site.
  • Provide technical support to installation teams, inspectors and customers, acting as a key point of contact for electrical and system-related queries.
  • Support the training and development of site and office-based colleagues, enabling effective first-line fault diagnosis and technical triage.
  • Liaise with manufacturers and equipment suppliers to resolve technical issues, faults and warranty matters.
  • Monitor installation quality and identify examples of best and poor practice, feeding learning into toolbox talks, training and best-practice guidance.
  • Deliver technical updates, toolbox talks and product awareness sessions to installation and inspection teams.
  • Review photographic evidence and job documentation to ensure installations can be effectively inspected remotely.
  • Ensure electrical installation work meets relevant engineering specifications, BS 7671, NICEIC requirements, MCS standards and applicable health, safety and environmental requirements.
  • Review electrical certificates, including EICs, Minor Works Certificates and EICRs, for accuracy and compliance.
  • Ensure project documentation is complete and meets relevant renewable energy certification requirements before sign-off.
  • Support internal and external quality, compliance and regulatory audits.
Person Specification: You will be an experienced electrical professional with a strong understanding of renewable energy installations and a genuine interest in maintaining high standards of workmanship and compliance.

  • A strong electrical installation background with relevant industry experience.
  • Practical knowledge of Solar PV, battery storage and associated inverter systems.
  • Experience of electrical inspection, testing and fault finding.
  • Good working knowledge of BS 7671.
  • Understanding of MCS requirements and renewable energy compliance.
  • Experience reviewing electrical certification and installation documentation.
  • The ability to diagnose and resolve technical issues both remotely and on-site.
  • NICEIC Qualifying Supervisor experience or an individual working towards this level would be highly desirable.
Salary & Benefits:

  • Salary up to £45,000 DOE
  • Company vehicle and fuel card.
  • Ongoing training and professional development.
  • Career progression within a growing renewable energy business.
  • Company pension.
  • Consistent workload across Solar PV, Battery Storage, EV Charging and Heat Pump projects.
  • Supportive team environment with a strong focus on quality, safety and continuous improvement.

Mobile AC Engineer – FM Service Provider – Kent Area – Van Mobile – Up to £48,000 + Package

CBW Staffing Solutions is currently recruiting for a Mobile Air Conditioning Engineer to carry out planned and reactive maintenance across a portfolio of commercial sites throughout the Kent area.

The successful candidate will have a strong background in air conditioning and refrigeration maintenance, with experience working across commercial buildings. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced AC Engineer looking for a stable mobile position with further training and progression available.

Hours of Work:
  • Monday to Friday
  • 08:00 – 17:00
  • Overtime available

Key Duties & Responsibilities:
  • Carrying out planned and reactive maintenance across air conditioning and refrigeration systems.
  • Servicing and maintaining split systems, VRVs, VRFs and VAV systems.
  • Maintenance of AHUs and FCUs.
  • Servicing and maintaining chillers and associated HVAC plant.
  • Carrying out fault finding and diagnosing AC and refrigeration issues.
  • Completing pressure and leak testing.
  • Carrying out compressor changes.
  • Brazing and associated refrigeration repairs.
  • Responding to reactive breakdowns and equipment faults.
  • Carrying out basic electrical fault finding where required.
  • Completing maintenance records and service reports.
  • Liaising with clients and site teams.
  • Ensuring all works are completed safely and in line with company procedures.

Package:
  • Up to £48,000 basic salary
  • Company van & fuel card
  • Private use of van
  • Travel paid after the first 30 minutes each way
  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays
  • Overtime available
  • Tablet and work phone provided
  • Full company uniform
  • Further training and development
  • Excellent career progression opportunities

Requirements:
  • City & Guilds Level 2 Air Conditioning & Refrigeration qualification or equivalent
  • F-Gas qualification – Essential
  • Proven experience servicing and maintaining commercial AC and HVAC systems.
  • Previous commercial building maintenance experience.
  • Strong fault-finding and diagnostic skills.
  • Electrical knowledge would be advantageous.
  • Good overall building services knowledge.
  • Multi-skilled approach to maintenance.
  • Must be able to provide copies of relevant trade certificates.
  • Good communication and client-facing skills.
  • Full UK Driving Licence.

Please send your CV to Bailey White at CBW Staffing Solutions to avoid missing out on this opportunity.

job.title: Access Control/ Intercom Engineer
job.description:
Access Control / Intercom Engineer – FM Service Provider – London (Foot Mobile) – £50,000 to £52,000 – CIS or PAYE Options Available

Exciting opportunity to work for an established FM service provider situated in London. CBW are currently recruiting for an Access Control / Intercom Engineer to work across seven high-end residential buildings, primarily around the Canary Wharf area.

The successful candidate will have proven experience servicing, maintaining, fault-finding and repairing access control, door entry and intercom systems within residential or commercial properties. In return, the company is offering a competitive salary of up to £52,000, overtime opportunities, and further technical training and development.

Package & Working Hours
  • £50,000 – £52,000 (depending on experience)
  • £180 – £220 per day CIS (depending on experience)
  • Overtime available
  • Working hours: 7.30am – 5.00pm Monday to Thursday & 7.30am – 4.00pm Friday
  • £160 per month travel allowance
  • 24 days holiday + bank holidays
  • Private healthcare insurance
  • Ongoing technical training and development
  • Company pension
Key Responsibilities
  • Carrying out planned preventative maintenance (PPMs) on access control, door entry and intercom systems.
  • Diagnosing faults and completing remedial works across a portfolio of high-end residential buildings.
  • Servicing and maintaining a wide range of systems including:
    • Audio and video intercom systems
    • Access control systems
    • Door entry systems
    • Magnetic locks and electric strikes
    • Proximity, fob and card access systems
    • Automatic door release systems
    • Gate entry systems (where applicable)
  • Installing and replacing access control and intercom equipment as required.
  • Programming and commissioning new or replacement devices.
  • Attending reactive call-outs and resolving system faults efficiently.
  • Participating in a 1-in-3 call-out rota after successfully settling into the role.
  • Liaising with residents, site teams and property managers to ensure excellent customer service.
  • Completing service reports and providing recommendations following maintenance visits.
  • Ensuring all work is completed in line with current industry standards and health & safety regulations.
Requirements
  • Proven experience working on access control, door entry and intercom systems.
  • Experience carrying out PPMs, servicing, repairs and fault-finding.
  • Knowledge of systems from manufacturers such as Paxton, Videx, BPT, Comelit, Hikvision, TDSi, Gallagher, Honeywell, Salto or similar.
  • Strong understanding of electronic security systems and associated hardware.
  • Full UK Driving Licence (preferred).
  • ECS Card or CSCS Card (preferred).
  • IPAF or PASMA (advantageous but not essential).
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently.
  • Excellent communication and customer-facing skills.
  • Ability to provide references and relevant industry qualifications.
If you are interested in this role, please contact Alex Denton from CBW Staffing Solutions

job.title: Project Coordinator
job.description:
Project Coordinator - Glasgow - Salary up to £30,000 DOE 

We are looking for an organised and proactive Project Coordinator to support the successful delivery of a growing portfolio of renewable energy installation programmes.

The role will involve managing schedules, coordinating site activity, maintaining accurate project records and providing clear progress reporting to ensure projects remain on programme. This is an ideal opportunity for someone with strong coordination or project administration experience who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment with multiple moving parts.

Key Responsibilities
  • Coordinate installation schedules across multiple live renewable energy programmes, aligning surveyor, installer and contractor availability with project deadlines.
  • Work closely with Project Managers to sequence works efficiently and, where practical, group projects geographically to minimise travel and downtime.
  • Confirm site access, customer appointments and pre-installation requirements ahead of scheduled works.
  • Maintain and regularly update programme schedules, ensuring changes, delays and completed works are accurately reflected.
  • Prepare, issue and track job packs, ensuring required documentation, permissions and compliance information are in place before works commence.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date project records, including job information, timesheets, installation evidence and completion documentation.
  • Follow up outstanding documentation with surveyors, installers and contractors and escalate persistent issues where required.
  • Support the preparation and collation of MCS, grant and funder-related documentation ahead of submission deadlines.
  • Ensure project records are complete, accurate and readily accessible throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Escalate customer concerns or complaints promptly to the appropriate Project Manager.
  • Build effective working relationships with internal and external stakeholders to support smooth project delivery.
  • Produce regular project and programme progress reports covering scheduled, completed and outstanding works.
  • Maintain accurate project data and ensure information is consistent across relevant systems.
  • Support Project Managers with data, reports and administrative packs for client meetings, project reviews, tenders and funder reporting.
  • Identify discrepancies or gaps in project information and work with relevant teams to resolve them.
  • Assist with the preparation of project tenders, including the collation of supporting documentation, method statements and pricing information.
  • Support the mobilisation of new projects and programmes by establishing job tracking, documentation and reporting processes.
  • Assist Project Managers with general project administration throughout the project lifecycle, from mobilisation through to completion and handover.
Person Specification:
  • Previous experience in project coordination, project support or project administration.
  • Experience within construction, installation, engineering, property, retrofit or renewable energy would be advantageous.
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple schedules, deadlines and stakeholders.
  • Excellent attention to detail, particularly when dealing with project records and compliance documentation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • A professional and confident approach when dealing with customers, contractors and internal teams.
  • Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
  • The ability to learn and use project management and job-tracking systems quickly.
  • A proactive approach to identifying scheduling conflicts, resource issues and potential project delays.
  • The ability to remain calm and methodical when managing a high volume of live projects and changing priorities.
Salary & Benefits:
  • Salary up to £30,000 DOE
  • Ongoing training and professional development.
  • Career progression within a growing renewable energy business.
  • Company pension.
  • Supportive team environment with a strong focus on quality, safety and continuous improvement.
